assets.prompt: Use case: precise architectural enhancement of a full spherical panorama. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an equirectangular 360-degree x 180-degree texture, NOT an ordinary wide photo. The image must remain a full seamless sphere: horizontal 360 degrees, vertical 180 degrees, exact 2:1 width-to-height. The left and right boundaries represent the same meridian and must join seamlessly; the top edge is zenith and bottom edge nadir. Do not straighten the curved pool or convert to rectilinear perspective. Improve realistic stone, wood, glazing, lush foliage, detailed water caustics and soft late afternoon light without changing the scene layout. Do NOT return a lower-resolution thumbnail or a cinematic photo; this must function as a 360 viewer texture. No text, watermark, logo, UI, borders or collage.
